announcements.title: Shad stuns Seyam 3–1 to set up a Legacy final showdown with Pranto
announcements.body:
The eFootball Tournament Legacy final is set. Shad Sajid produced the performance of the semi-finals, beating Mahmudul Hasan Seyam 3–1 with a display of attacking control that few saw coming against one of the tournament's form players.

The numbers are one-sided. Shad fired 13 shots to Seyam's 3, put 7 on target to Seyam's 1, and kept 54% of the ball while winning the interception battle 34–25. Seyam tackled bravely — 11 tackles on the night — and his goalkeeper made 3 saves to keep the score from growing heavier, but his only shot on target brought his single goal on a night when he was simply outplayed.

Shad now goes into the final against Club President Tanvir Ahmed Pranto, who won his own semi-final on penalties — a final between the tournament's great entertainer and its coolest head. After the match, Club President Tanvir Ahmed Pranto congratulated Shad on an outstanding victory and wished him good luck for the final ahead.

announcements.title: Pranto beats Rafi on penalties after a 2–2 thriller to reach the Legacy final
announcements.body:
The eFootball Tournament Legacy has its first finalist — and it is the President himself. Tanvir Ahmed Pranto and Rafiul Hasan Rafi could not be separated in a pulsating semi-final that finished 2–2, before Pranto held his nerve in the penalty shootout, winning it 3–2 to book his place in the final.

The numbers show how little there was between them. Pranto edged possession 53% to 47%, but Rafi carried the greater threat — 8 shots to 7, and 5 on target to Pranto's 3 — and Pranto's goalkeeper was the busier man, making 3 saves to keep his side level. Rafi also completed more passes, 138 of his 167, and won the interception battle 31–24, but Pranto won 10 tackles to 5 and simply refused to be beaten. When the tie went to spot-kicks, he and his side converted when it mattered most.

Pranto now goes into the final, where Shad Sajid will stand across from him after his 3–1 win over Seyam in the other semi-final. After the match, Pranto congratulated Rafi on a magnificent semi-final performance and wished both finalists the very best of luck for the final.

announcements.title: Seyam storms into the last four: 6–3 win over Kisor in a nine-goal thriller
announcements.body:
The eFootball Tournament Legacy has its third semi-finalist. Mahmudul Hasan Seyam beat Kisor Mahmud Hridoy 6–3 in a nine-goal quarter-final classic — an outstanding victory in the highest-scoring match of the tournament so far.

The numbers show an attacking masterclass. Seyam kept 56% of the ball, fired 19 shots with 13 on target, and completed 152 of his 191 passes, while his 48 interceptions smothered Kisor's build-up play. But Kisor refused to go quietly: he scored three times, put 8 shots on target and won 13 tackles, and only his goalkeeper's 7 saves kept Seyam's score at six. It was end-to-end football from two players who both came to attack.

Seyam now waits in the semi-final for the winner of the last quarter-final, Nasim Khan against Shad Sajid, while the other semi-final is already set: Pranto against Rafi. After the match, Club President Tanvir Ahmed Pranto congratulated Seyam on the outstanding win and wished him good luck for the semi-final ahead.

announcements.title: Pranto beats Sadi 3–1 to set up a semi-final showdown with Rafi
announcements.body:
The eFootball Tournament Legacy has its second semi-finalist — and it is the President himself. Tanvir Ahmed Pranto beat MD. Saifullah Sadi 3–1 in the quarter-final, an outstanding victory that carries him into the last four.

The numbers show a match Pranto controlled from start to finish. His AC Milan side kept 58% of the ball and fired 12 shots, 9 of them on target, while Sadi managed just 2 efforts on target all game. Pranto also won the interception battle 30–22, breaking up Sadi's play before it could build. Only a heroic display from Sadi's goalkeeper — 7 saves — kept the scoreline respectable, and Sadi's goal was a consolation against the run of play.

Pranto now goes into a blockbuster semi-final against Rafiul Hasan Rafi — the man who won his own quarter-final 6–0 — in a tie that already looks like a final before the final. After the match, Pranto congratulated Sadi on a brave performance and wished everyone left in the tournament the very best of luck for the semi-finals.

announcements.title: Rafi runs riot: 6–0 demolition of Farhan sends him into the Legacy semi-finals
announcements.body:
The eFootball Tournament Legacy has its first semi-finalist — and he announced himself in style. Rafiul Hasan Rafi thrashed Farhan Mahee 6–0 in the quarter-final, an outstanding victory that sets the standard for everyone still left in the tournament.

The numbers behind the scoreline are remarkable. Farhan actually saw more of the ball — 52% possession, more passes and more completed passes — but Rafi's Internazionale Milano were devastating going forward: 14 shots, 11 of them on target, and six goals. Farhan's goalkeeper made 6 saves on the night, and without him the margin could have been even heavier. Rafi also won the interception battle 35–28, cutting out Farhan's build-up play again and again — a complete performance with and without the ball.

Rafi now waits in the last four while the remaining quarter-finals are played, and on this form he will fear nobody in the semi-final. After the match, Club President Tanvir Ahmed Pranto congratulated Rafi on the outstanding win and wished him good luck for the semi-final ahead.
